LAB_RESULT_COMMENT: In the Netherlands, influenza B/Yamagata influenza virus RNA was detected in a specimen collected in week 42 by a sentinel general practitioner (GP) in a patient (aged 65 and above) displaying symptoms of influenza-like illness (ILI). The patient was sampled about a week before the GP practice started with season Influenza vaccination, and therefore specimen contamination with flu vaccine RNA was not likely. Furthermore, in the Netherlands only inactivated influenza vaccines are used in the national influenza vaccination programme. Influenza virus type B sequencing and virus isolation have been started but given the very low amount of influenza virus RNA in the specimen success is not guaranteed.
